## Sorting the starting backlog

`2 MERGED · 2 CLOSED`{.progress-timeline-status}

**Week 2 · June 1–7**

## Keeping year selection without the colour legend

`OPEN AT AUG 24 CUTOFF`{.progress-timeline-status}

**PR #336** added `showSelected.legend = FALSE`, preserving explicit `year` selection while preventing the colour legend from silently adding `region`. It was open and ready on August 24 and merged August 25.

**[PR #336](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/336)** · **[Issue #333](https://github.com/animint/animint2/issues/333)** · [Read journal →](/journal/week-2/){.progress-journal-link}

**Week 3 · June 8–14**

## Three red CI jobs, three different causes

`1 MERGED · 3 INVESTIGATIONS`{.progress-timeline-status}

**PR #337** fixed a leaked one-second Chromote timeout and merged. Separate investigations traced other failures to fork credentials and `atime` package loading, while **PR #339** began the multiline facet-strip work.

**[PR #337](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/337)** · **[PR #339](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/339)** · [Read journal →](/journal/week-3/){.progress-journal-link}

## Checking where the CI fixes belonged

`VALIDATION · SCOPE`{.progress-timeline-status}

**Week 8 · July 13–19**

## The labels split, but still covered the plot

`OPEN · GEOMETRY VERIFIED`{.progress-timeline-status}

**PR #339** already split facet labels into SVG lines, but the extra line could overlap the panel. A browser-geometry test exposed that problem, and the renderer was updated to measure and reserve space for every line.

**[PR #339](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/339)** · [Read journal →](/journal/week-8/){.progress-journal-link}

**Week 12 · August 10–16**

## Making a histogram recompute after selection

`POC · OPEN AT CUTOFF`{.progress-timeline-status}

**PR #343** began with a failing browser test: selecting different rows should change histogram counts without moving the bin boundaries. The raw-value and fixed-break design started here; the complete JavaScript path followed during Final Submission.

**[PR #343](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/343)** · **[Issue #158](https://github.com/animint/animint2/issues/158)** · [Read journal →](/journal/week-12/){.progress-journal-link}
